revision_history.build_notes:
Built from: - v1.0 (research_dossier_template_v1.0.xml) - Template Review and Optimization document (template_review_output.md) - Operator Build Prompt for v1.1
Two operator decisions govern v1.1 and supersede review recommendations where they conflict:
DECISION 1 — Routing profile assignment is removed from the research template. The template is rubric-agnostic. It collects three routing inputs (target raise, development stage, investor composition) and a routing confidence assessment. The evaluator — operating in a separate context with the relevant scoring rubric — assigns the profile.
DECISION 2 — The template is a pure research document. It produces evidence only. No scoring language, profile assignment, tier labels, fundraising readiness assessments, or rubric-specific vocabulary appear anywhere in the dossier. A separate evaluation engine consumes the evidence and produces scores. This template does not know which rubric will consume its output.
revision_history.version_history: v1.0 — Initial research dossier template; tightly coupled to the Technology ICP Evaluation Instrument; phase-based structure (Phase 1 through Phase 5). v1.1 — Rubric-agnostic block-based structure (R0 through R8); six-tag classification system formalized; 12-disqualifier schema with applicability pre-assessment; Sonnet Entity Manifest incorporated verbatim as OI-3; Routing Ambiguity Protocol added; A6/B6-equivalent force-test and Helmer Powers research mandated in C2 and C6; per-criterion call floors with C7 elevated to ≥4 calls; classification system expanded from two tags (INFORMATION- SCARCE / INFORMATION-ABSENT) to six (CONFIRMED, COMPANY-CLAIMED, PARTIALLY CONFIRMED, INFORMATION-SCARCE, INFORMATION-ABSENT, REQUIRES-FOUNDER-ATTESTATION); routing profile assignment removed; Phase 2 rubric attachment removed from operator inputs (former OI-4 eliminated); ten-condition Completion Gate (CG-1 through CG-10); Surfaced Individuals Log and Ambiguous Attribution Flag mechanisms formalized.

deferred_revisions.entry: The investor composition disambiguation table (R2.3) records vehicle type and participation type but does not assign a named tier. A future revision may add a generic descriptive tier vocabulary compatible across rubrics.
The R2.5 enumerated development stage list is generic. A future revision may add a more formal industry-specific stage schema with explicit cross-walks to the generic list.

entry.title: Per-Criterion Floor Recalibration After Initial Corpus

deferred_revisions.entry: The minimum-call floors per criterion (RP-6) reflect v1.1 design judgments. After 5-10 dossiers, floors should be recalibrated based on observed under/over-coverage patterns.

entry.title: Output Format Specification for Scoring Engine Consumption

deferred_revisions.entry: The current R8 handoff block is human-readable. A future revision may produce a structured JSON or XML handoff payload for programmatic scoring engine consumption.
DQ-k addresses OFAC SDN counterparty connections. Additional briefs may be added for ITAR, EAR, FARA, CFIUS, and non-US equivalents.
